title: If you never slept again, how long until you die?

lines.text: If you never slept again, how long would it take for you to die?
Night one. The city sleeps. You don't.
Day two. Your reactions are as bad as a drunk driver's.
Day four. The walls breathe. Your brain steals tiny naps without asking.
You'd think you'd drop dead by now. You don't. In 1964, Randy Gardner stayed awake for eleven days, and lived.
But lab rats kept awake die within weeks.
Day twenty three. You step off the kerb, and close your eyes. Just for a second.
You died. Comment what stupid shenanigans Gary should try tomorrow.
